typography.fallback: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

component_patterns.header: Dark navy sticky header; ABNEOS wordmark in Outfit; compact square mark with teal/gold/sky accents; CTA in royal blue.
component_patterns.navigation: Rounded-md dark active states; compact text; mobile menu stays navy.
component_patterns.buttons: Primary royal blue #155EEF with rounded-xl corners; white text; hover #1049BD. Secondary patterns derive from navy/teal surfaces.
component_patterns.cards: Use restrained rounded-xl/2xl white or navy surfaces, clear borders, minimal shadow; avoid decorative gradients unless already present in source.
component_patterns.focus: 3px royal outline on light surfaces; sky outline on dark navy.

visual_grammar.tone: Professional, technical, outcome-led; dark navy anchors with royal/teal accents and limited gold highlight.
visual_grammar.density: Structured and relatively compact rather than oversized generic SaaS hero styling.
visual_grammar.icons: Lucide icons used as functional accents; small contained icon surfaces are acceptable.
visual_grammar.imagery: Use real/project-specific imagery where available; do not substitute abstract purple gradient art.
visual_grammar.graphics: For branded social graphics, use navy as the dominant anchor, royal/teal accents, Outfit-led headings and restrained geometric structure. Gold should be a minor highlight, not the main field.

prohibited: typography other than documented brand families unless technically unavoidable
